Topic.label: Representing Solution Sets of Inequalities on a Number Line

Question: Represent \(x\ge-1\) on a number line. Which description of how to draw it is correct?

Choices.A: Draw an open circle at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the right.
Choices.B: Draw a filled dot at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the left.
Choices.C: Draw a filled dot at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the right.
Choices.D: Draw an open circle at \(-1\) and a ray extending to the left.

Solution: Use a filled dot when equality is included. Since \(x\) is greater than or equal to \(-1\), the ray extends to the right.

Original.explanation: 含等号用实心点；x 大于或等于 -1，所以射线向右。
